arguments.content: P1 — Delayed cleanup must preserve ownership across successive setup attempts. Serialized store operations still allow a failed job's cleanup to run after a replacement setup succeeds; no concurrent execution is needed. When the active record is keyed by workspace while cleanup is scoped to a setup attempt, unconditional deletion can remove the replacement's connection. Preserve the setup identity check before deletion, and validate the full failed-attempt → replacement success → delayed cleanup sequence through the connection reader. Same-attempt cleanup tests alone miss this temporal ownership regression.
